_comment: #1150: DB-writing scripts that do not yet open the DB through openRepairDb(). Shrink-only: scripts/ci/require-db-writer-guard.mjs fails when a listed file is guarded, exempted or deleted, so remove the entry in the same change. Never add an entry to make a NEW script pass.
